title: Quota fit is not node fit: the pods-ready timeout, and topology-aware admission
design_ref: Gang scheduling: all or nothing (waitForPodsReady); Topology-aware gang placement
purpose: Rack b1-r1 has 8 free GPUs, but the queue has 16 GPUs of quota. Submit a 12-pod job through a queue without topology: Kueue admits it, only 8 pods can run, and waitForPodsReady (60 s here) must evict and requeue it. Then free the rack and watch it start. Finally submit the same job through a topology-aware queue, which checks the rack's real free GPUs before admitting.

steps.display: kubectl apply -f filler.yaml   # 3 pods x 8 GPUs: rack b1-r1 keeps 8 of 32 GPUs free
kubectl apply -f train-12.yaml   # 12 pods x 1 GPU, queue plain (flavor without topology)
after the filler is deleted (rack fully free)
kubectl apply -f filler.yaml   # the same 3 x 8 GPUs: rack b1-r1 keeps 8 free
kubectl apply -f train-12-tas.yaml   # the same job, queue tas (flavor with topology), podset-required-topology: rack

steps.output: {"admitted": false, "pods": {"running": 0, "pending": 0, "gpus_held": 0}, "message": "couldn't assign flavors to pod set main: topology \"ds17-fabric\" allows to fit only 8 out of 12 pod(s); all pods must fit in a single \"network.ds17.io/rack\" topology domain. Total nodes: 16; excluded: nodeSelector: 12, resource \"nvidia.com/gpu\": 3"}

checks.description: Kueue admits the job on quota, 8 pods run and 4 stay pending, and after the 60 s timeout the workload is evicted (PodsReadyTimeout) and requeued with backoff
checks.because: waitForPodsReady: all pods of an admitted workload must be ready within the timeout, or it gives its quota back and waits.

checks.description: once the rack has room, the requeued workload is admitted again and all 12 pods run
checks.because: The requeue backoff expired and the quota still fitted; this time the nodes did too.

checks.description: through the topology-aware queue the job is not admitted while the rack lacks 12 free GPUs, and holds none
checks.because: TAS checks the free GPUs of the topology domain, including those used by pods Kueue does not manage, before it admits.
